purpose: Paired bottleneck diagnosis: do short descriptions of the same three study images change diagnostic accuracy?
sampling: Previously deduplicated fixed-seed official training pool. Exclude all case IDs in pilot/development, pilot/heldout and all six panels of each prior single- and multi-tool learning run (480 distinct in total). Take the first 32 remaining with a CT image and first 32 without, at most 27 usable views, without consulting captions, answer, or predictions. Fix first three catalog views. No replacements.
arms: direct: image triplet, history, options; self: identical inputs plus a short finding generated independently for each image by frozen Qwen, without history, options or captions; checked: same inputs plus purely descriptive text extracted from corresponding official image captions. All three share diagnostic prompt, label-scoring, processor and deterministic decoding. The self arm has three additional inference-time description calls. Checked captions are privileged evidence for diagnosis, not deployable.
annotation: Extract one contiguous English caption span per image, at most 35 words. Drop explicit option text, initialisms and conclusion phrases; separately check the span against original caption for grounding and the shuffled-label-free list of all diagnoses for semantic disclosure (synonyms/subtypes/abbreviations). Both binary checks must pass. One shorter extractive repair; otherwise an empty note. Local Qwen checks, not clinical adjudication. No use of correct answer or diagnostic predictions for note selection. Seal references before generating diagnostic outcomes.
omissions: For each nonempty checked span, compare self description to that span for the same image using a blinded frozen judge. Classify main observation as covered, omitted/insufficient, or contradicted. Save per-image text and per-case paired outcomes privately. Omitted means absent from the written note, not proof the model never perceived it.
endpoints: Primary checked vs direct. Also self vs direct and checked vs self. Report paired gains/losses, exact two-sided McNemar, diagnostic accuracy, both strata and annotation coverage. Descriptive screening threshold of >=4 net additional correct/64 for a material signal; p<0.05 to label primary evidence supported. Below 48 cases with any approved note, insufficient coverage to conclude a lack of benefit. Comparable self performance on this pilot means similar observed counts only, not equivalence. No test-set tuning.
